info.name: SnackRapido - Restaurants Service
info.description:
GraphQL API for the SnackRapido Restaurants microservice (port 4001).

Auth flow:
1. Register Restaurant → get activation_token
2. Activate → get restaurant
3. Login → get accessToken + refreshToken
4. Use tokens in headers for protected routes

Protected routes require:
- accesstoken header
- refreshtoken header

request.description: Register a new restaurant. Returns activation_token — check email/console for the 4-digit code.
Activate the restaurant with the token (auto-saved) and the 4-digit code from email/console.
Login with email/password. Tokens are auto-saved to collection variables.
Get the currently authenticated restaurant's full profile.
Find restaurants near a location. coordinates: [longitude, latitude]. maxDistance in meters.
